Bootcamp Workshop Targeting

Tier 1 (Bootcamp) stores only, ranked by area. A store is Bootcamp-tier when its 3-month average 5-Star score (<2.5) is below threshold — i.e. the baseline, not just the latest month. Concentration = share of that area's total stores that are Bootcamp-tier. Workshop Focus = what the session should cover. Boot Camp Attendance = restaurants completed (green) or scheduled (amber) in that area in this window. The # is a priority rank to target first: 40% Bootcamp count + 40% concentration + 20% lower baseline score. Click a column header to re-sort rows (the # stays fixed). Click an area row to expand its stores with baseline score and attendance.
